<div class="card-body">
'''Concussion Grenade''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">コンカッション・グレネード</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して任意の戦士に配備する。同じ位置か隣接位置にむかって“投げる”ことができる。運命数を引く。その位置にいる、同じ運命数を持った全てのキャラクター、武器、アイテムはロストする。運命数＝０の場合は、グレネードを投げた自分の戦士だけがロストする。コンカッション・グレネードもロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Concussion-Grenade-PSA-152940012.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ミア＝ランＶ－５９グレネード。破壊力は抜群</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Concussion grenade.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on any warrior. May 'throw' toward the same or an adjacent location. Draw destiny. All characters, weapons and devices at that location with that destiny number are lost. If destiny = 0, only your warrior who threw the grenade is lost. The concussion grenade is also lost.

'''Lore:'''
Mier-Lan V-59 grenade. Outstanding destructive power.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says the grenade's destructive power is outstanding; the English lore says it blows stuff up.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Concussion Grenade]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
